summary.zh: 明万历十六年（1588年），明神宗在清算张居正（1582年去世）的过程中将其改革措施大部分废止。张居正推行的考成法被废弃，官吏考核恢复旧制，行政效率大幅下降。一条鞭法虽名义上保留但执行走样。张居正的家属被抄家，长子张敬修自杀。神宗对张居正的彻底否定标志着万历中兴的终结，此后神宗更加怠政，明朝政治加速腐败。

statement.zh: 明万历16年（1588年），明神宗在清算张居正（1582年去世）的过程中将其改革措施大部分废止。张居正推行的考成法被废弃，官吏考核恢复旧制，行政效率大幅下降。一条鞭法虽名义上保留但执行走样。张居正的家属被抄家，长子张敬修自杀。神宗对张居正的彻底否定标志着万历中兴的终结，此后神宗更加怠政，明朝政治加速腐败。
statement.en:
In the 16th year of Wanli (1588), the Wanli Emperor, having purged Zhang Juzheng (who died in 1582), largely repealed his reform measures. The Examination Law was abandoned, reverting to old evaluation methods, leading to a sharp decline in administrative efficiency. The Single Whip Law was nominally retained but poorly enforced. Zhang's family was confiscated and his eldest son committed suicide. The emperor's complete repudiation of Zhang marked the end of the Wanli Restoration. Thereafter, the Wanli Emperor became even more neglectful of state affairs, and Ming political decay accelerated.

For Asia in 1588, “Ming Reverses Zhang Juzheng's Reforms” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 日本天正十六年（1588年），丰臣秀吉担心基督教在九州等地的大名势力过大且可能成为欧洲殖民的先锋，颁布了《伴天连追放令》（即禁教令），命令所有天主教传教士在二十天内离开日本。秀吉将长崎等地从大名手中收回直辖，禁止大名皈依基督教。这是日本历史上第一次正式禁教，但初期执行并不彻底，德川幕府时期禁教才完全严格化。

statement.zh: 日本天正16年（1588年），丰臣秀吉担心基督教在九州等地的大名势力过大且可能成为欧洲殖民的先锋，颁布了《伴天连追放令》（即禁教令），命令所有天主教传教士在二十天内离开日本。秀吉将长崎等地从大名手中收回直辖，禁止大名皈依基督教。这是日本历史上第一次正式禁教，但初期执行并不彻底，德川幕府时期禁教才完全严格化。
statement.en:
In 1588 (Tensho 16), concerned that Christianity among Kyushu daimyo might become too powerful and serve as a vanguard for European colonization, Toyotomi Hideyoshi issued the 'Bateren Tsuiho Rei' (Expulsion of the Padres), ordering all Christian missionaries to leave Japan within twenty days. Hideyoshi took control of Nagasaki and other places from daimyo and forbade daimyo from converting to Christianity. This was the first formal ban on Christianity in Japanese history, but it was not strictly enforced at first; the ban became absolute during the Tokugawa shogunate.

For Asia in 1588, “Toyotomi Hideyoshi Bans Christianity” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 威廉·李发明手动织袜机

summary.zh: 公元1589年，英国牧师威廉·李（William Lee）发明了手动织袜机（stocking frame），可一次性编织整只袜子。伊丽莎白一世拒绝授予他专利，李带着机器和工人前往法国。织袜机是工业革命前最重要的纺织机械创新之一，其工作原理（钩针编织）奠定了现代针织业基础。

summary.zh: 明万历十七年（1589年）以后，明神宗长期不上朝、不处理政务，官员升迁受阻、政务荒废。顾宪成等一批官员在东林书院讲学议政，形成了"东林党"。与之对立的是以沈一贯为首的"浙党"和以方从哲为首的"楚党"。各党派互相攻讦、争权夺利，朝政日益混乱。党争一直延续到明朝灭亡，对明末政治产生了极其恶劣的影响。

statement.en:
After 1589 (17th year of Wanli), the Wanli Emperor stopped attending court and handling affairs for long periods, causing officials' promotions to stall and government to decay. A group of officials, including Gu Xiancheng, lectured on politics at the Donglin Academy, forming the 'Donglin Party'. Their opponents included the 'Zhe Party' led by Shen Yiguan and the 'Chu Party' led by Fang Congzhe. The factions attacked each other and fought for power, plunging the court into chaos. Factional strife continued until the end of the Ming dynasty and had an extremely negative impact on late Ming politics.

For Asia in 1589, “Ming Court Factional Strife Begins” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 日本准备侵朝军队集结

summary.zh: 日本天正十九年（1591年），丰臣秀吉完成入侵朝鲜的军事准备工作。他在肥前国名护屋（今佐贺县）修建了庞大的大本营和后勤基地。动员了约15万陆军和约1万海军，分为九个军团，分别由小西行长、加藤清正、福岛正则等大名担任先锋。秀吉向朝鲜国王宣战要求"借道伐明"，遭拒绝后于1592年4月正式出兵。

statement.zh: 日本天正19年（1591年），丰臣秀吉完成入侵朝鲜的军事准备工作。他在肥前国名护屋（今佐贺县）修建了庞大的大本营和后勤基地。动员了约15万陆军和约1万海军，分为九个军团，分别由小西行长、加藤清正、福岛正则等大名担任先锋。秀吉向朝鲜国王宣战要求"借道伐明"，遭拒绝后于1592年4月正式出兵。
statement.en:
In 1591 (Tensho 19), Toyotomi Hideyoshi completed preparations for the invasion of Korea. He built a huge headquarters and logistics base at Nagoya in Hizen Province (present-day Saga Prefecture). He mobilized about 150,000 army and 10,000 naval troops, divided into nine field divisions, with commanders including Konishi Yukinaga, Katō Kiyomasa, and Fukushima Masanori as vanguards. Hideyoshi demanded that the king of Korea allow passage to attack the Ming; when the king refused, Hideyoshi ordered the invasion in April 1592.

For Asia in 1591, “Japanese Invasion Force Assembled” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en: The Qutb Shahi dynasty founds Hyderabad on the Musi river; famed for pearl trade and Islamic art, it became a Deccan centre.

title.zh: 努尔哈赤统一建州女真

summary.zh: 建州女真首领努尔哈赤以"复仇"名义攻打尼堪外兰部，先后征服苏克苏浒、哲陈等部，逐步统一建州女真各部。努尔哈赤以十三副遗甲起兵，采取"恩威并施"的策略，抚绥归附者，武力征服抵抗者，为建立后金政权奠定了军事基础。

statement.en: Nurhaci, chieftain of the Jianzhou Jurchens, under the banner of vengeance, attacked the Nikan Wailan tribe and subsequently subdued the Suksuhu, Jecen, and other tribes, gradually unifying the Jianzhou Jurchen tribes.

In June 1592 (20th year of Wanli), the Korean king Seonjo's envoys arrived in Beijing. The Wanli Emperor and his ministers debated and eventually decided to send troops to aid Korea. Song Yingchang was appointed commander-in-chief (Jinglue) to lead the Ming army into Korea.

For Asia in 1592, “Ming Decides to Aid Korea” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 李舜臣以鹤翼阵在闲山岛外海全歼日军舰队，夺回制海权，切断日军海上补给，扭转壬辰战局。鹤翼阵把舰队展开为两翼包抄的队形，配合火炮与弓箭的集中射击，使敌军难以突入；制海权的转移直接影响了陆上战场的补给与兵力调动。海战的胜利证明水师可以决定战争的走向，也成为朝鲜水军的代表战例。
statement.en: Admiral Yi Sun-sin's crane-wing formation annihilated the Japanese fleet off Hansan Island, seizing command of the sea, severing the invaders' supply line and turning the course of the Imjin War.

statement.zh: 万历二十年（1592年），金陵世德堂刊行《新刻出像官板大字西游记》二十卷一百回，这是现存最早的《西游记》全本。小说一般认为出自吴承恩（约1500—1582）之手，敷演唐僧师徒西天取经故事，为中国神魔小说的巅峰。
statement.en:
In the 20th year of Wanli (1592), the Shidetang workshop in Nanjing printed the Xinke chuxiang guanban dazi Xiyou ji — twenty juan in one hundred chapters — the earliest surviving complete edition of Journey to the West. The novel is generally attributed to Wu Cheng'en (c. 1500–1582) and recounts the Tang monk and his disciples' pilgrimage for scriptures, standing as the pinnacle of Chinese supernatural fiction.

For Asia in 1592, “Journey to the West printed (Shidetang edition)” is a traceable node of Literature change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 明日议和谈判开启，秀吉提出七条要求

summary.zh: 万历二十一年，碧蹄馆之战与幸州之败后，明军与日军皆无力速决，双方转入议和。沈惟敬赴肥前名护屋会见丰臣秀吉，秀吉提出迎明朝公主为日本后妃、恢复勘合贸易、割朝鲜南四道等七条要求。小西行长与沈惟敬各自欺瞒本国朝廷，谎称对方乞降，真相被掩盖三年，直至1596年明册封使抵日，秀吉见诏书仅封其为“日本国王”而勃然大怒，和谈彻底破裂。

statement.zh: 万历二十一年，碧蹄馆之战与幸州之败后，明军与日军皆无力速决，双方转入议和。沈惟敬赴肥前名护屋会见丰臣秀吉，秀吉提出迎明朝公主为日本后妃、恢复勘合贸易、割朝鲜南四道等七条要求。小西行长与沈惟敬各自欺瞒本国朝廷，谎称对方乞降，真相被掩盖三年，直至1596年明册封使抵日，秀吉见诏书仅封其为“日本国王”而勃然大怒，和谈彻底破裂。
statement.en:
After Byeokjegwan and Haengju in 1593 neither the Ming nor the Japanese could force a decision, and both turned to negotiation. Shen Weijing travelled to Nagoya in Hizen to meet Toyotomi Hideyoshi, who set out seven demands including a Ming princess as an imperial consort, the reopening of tally trade, and the cession of Korea’s four southern provinces. Konishi Yukinaga and Shen Weijing each deceived their own court, reporting that the other side had sued for peace. The deception held for three years, until the Ming investiture mission reached Japan in 1596 and Hideyoshi, finding himself merely styled “King of Japan”, broke off the talks in fury.

For Asia in 1593, “Ming–Japan peace talks open; Hideyoshi presents seven demands” is a traceable node of Diplomacy change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.en:
In February 1593 (21st year of Wanli), Ming commander Li Rusong led his forces against the Japanese at Byeokjegwan (north of present-day Seoul). About 3,000 Ming soldiers were surrounded by 10,000 of Japanese, suffering hundreds of casualties before breaking out. After the battle, the two sides reached a stalemate.

For Asia in 1593, “Battle of Byeokjegwan” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 伽利略发明空气温度计

summary.zh: 意大利科学家伽利略制成以空气热胀冷缩指示温度的早期温度计，开温度计量先河。

statement.zh:
意大利科学家伽利略制成以空气热胀冷缩指示温度的早期温度计，开温度计量先河。装置以玻璃管中的空气受热膨胀推动液柱，读数还会受气压影响；它把冷热从主观感觉转为可以比较的指示，为温度计的改进开辟路径。温度的量化随后成为气象与实验科学的基础工具。

summary.zh: 明万历二十二年（1594年），明朝援朝抗倭战争进入相持阶段。明军与丰臣秀吉的日军在朝鲜南部从平壤到釜山的战线上形成僵持局面。双方在碧蹄馆（1593年）激战互有胜负后，明军采取"围城打援"策略，在釜山等地与日军对峙。日军因补给困难主动收缩，明朝则因国内问题不愿继续投入大量军费。双方开始进行和谈，为1597年的第二次开战埋下伏笔。

statement.en:
In 1594 (22nd year of Wanli), the Ming expedition against Japan entered a stalemate. The Ming forces and Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Japanese armies faced each other on a line from Pyongyang to Busan in southern Korea. After the fierce but indecisive Battle of Byeokjegwan, the Ming adopted a strategy of blockading Japanese-held fortresses. The Japanese, facing supply difficulties, voluntarily withdrew. The two sides began peace negotiations, which set the stage for the second war in 1597.

For Asia in 1594, “Stalemate in Ming Korean Expedition” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 1594年，九名阿姆斯特丹商人集资组建"远方公司"（Compagnie van Verre）。次年该公司派科内利斯·德·郝特曼率四船绕好望角东航，1597年归来时仅剩三船、八十七人（出发时约二百四十九人），但带回的胡椒足以获利。这证明荷兰人可以绕开葡萄牙人直航东印度。此后至1601年间，荷兰各城相继涌现十余家"前公司"（voorcompagnieën），六十余艘船竞相东下，彼此在产地抬价、在本国压价，利润迅速摊薄。为终止内耗并合力对抗葡萄牙与西班牙，议会大议长奥尔登巴内费尔特出面斡旋，诸公司于1602年合并为荷兰东印度公司（VOC）。
statement.en: In 1594 nine Amsterdam merchants pooled their capital to form the Compagnie van Verre. The next year it sent four ships east around the Cape under Cornelis de Houtman; when they returned in 1597 only three vessels and 87 of some two hundred and 49 men survived, but the pepper they brought back showed a profit and proved that the Dutch could reach the East Indies without the Portuguese. Between then and 1601 more than a dozen such 'pre-companies' sprang up in the Dutch towns and over sixty ships sailed east, bidding prices up at the source and down at home until margins collapsed. To end the competition and concentrate force against Portugal and Spain, the Land's Advocate Johan van Oldenbarnevelt brokered their merger into the Dutch East India Company (VOC) in 1602.

en: In 1594 nine Amsterdam merchants pooled their capital to form the Compagnie van Verre. The next year it sent four ships east around the Cape under Cornelis de Houtman; when they returned in 1597 only three vessels and 87 of some two hundred and 49 men survived, but the pepper they brought back showed a profit and proved that the Dutch could reach the East Indies without the Portuguese. Between then and 1601 more than a dozen such 'pre-companies' sprang up in the Dutch towns and over sixty ships sailed east, bidding prices up at the source and down at home until margins collapsed. To end the competition and concentrate force against Portugal and Spain, the Land's Advocate Johan van Oldenbarnevelt brokered their merger into the Dutch East India Company (VOC) in 1602.

title.zh: 莎士比亚创作《罗密欧与朱丽叶》

summary.zh: 公元1595年左右，莎士比亚完成了悲剧《罗密欧与朱丽叶》。该剧讲述了意大利维罗纳两个世仇家族中年轻恋人因家族仇恨而殉情的爱情悲剧。莎士比亚将原故事的时间从九个月压缩到五天，增加了麦丘提奥、奶妈等生动角色。该剧在伦敦首次上演即大获成功，至今仍是世界戏剧舞台上演出最多的剧作之一。

statement.zh: 明万历23年（1595年），明朝与日本丰臣政权之间的和谈彻底破裂。此前明廷册封丰臣秀吉为"日本国王"，但秀吉拒绝接受明朝的要求（从朝鲜撤军、不与明朝公主和亲），认为明朝的册封是对其尊严的侮辱。丰臣秀吉下令驱逐明使，于1597年发动第二次侵朝战争（丁酉再乱）。明朝再次派遣大军入朝援救，与日军在朝鲜南部展开激战。
statement.en:
In 1595 (23rd year of Wanli), peace negotiations between the Ming and Toyotomi Hideyoshi completely broke down. The Ming had enfeoffed Hideyoshi as 'King of Japan', but he refused to accept the Ming terms (withdrawal from Korea, no marriage with a Ming princess). Hideyoshi considered the enfeoffment an insult to his dignity and expelled the Ming envoys, then in 1597 launched a second invasion of Korea (Jeongyu War). The Ming again sent large forces to Korea and engaged the Japanese in fierce combat in southern Korea.

For Asia in 1595, “Ming-Japanese Peace Talks Collapse” is a traceable node of Diplomacy change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 明朝册封丰臣秀吉为"日本国王"

summary.zh: 明万历二十四年（1596年）九月，明廷正使杨方亨等抵大坂城，册封丰臣秀吉为"日本国王"，授诰命与金印，欲以宗藩之礼了结壬辰战争的议和。秀吉原冀明朝以对等之礼相待，并割朝鲜南四道，闻诏书仅以藩属国王视之，勃然大怒，撕毁和议、逐还明使。次年（万历二十五年）秀吉再遣大军渡海，是为"丁酉再乱"（庆长之役）。

statement.zh: 明万历24年（1596年）九月，明廷正使杨方亨等抵大坂城，册封丰臣秀吉为"日本国王"，授诰命与金印，欲以宗藩之礼了结壬辰战争的议和。秀吉原冀明朝以对等之礼相待，并割朝鲜南四道，闻诏书仅以藩属国王视之，勃然大怒，撕毁和议、逐还明使。次年（万历二十五年）秀吉再遣大军渡海，是为"丁酉再乱"（庆长之役）。
statement.en:
In the ninth month of 1596 (24th year of Wanli) the Ming envoy Yang Fangheng reached Osaka Castle and invested Toyotomi Hideyoshi as "King of Japan", conferring a patent of investiture and a gold seal in the hope of closing the Imjin War on tributary terms. Hideyoshi had expected to be treated as an equal and to receive the four southern provinces of Korea; on learning that the edict cast him merely as a vassal king he flew into a rage, repudiated the settlement and expelled the envoys. The following year he sent his armies across the strait again in the Jeongyu (Keichō) campaign.

For Asia in 1596, “The Ming invests Toyotomi Hideyoshi as "King of Japan"” is a traceable node of Diplomacy change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 明万历24年（1596年），明神宗朱翊钧为弥补日益枯竭的国库，派遣大量宦官充任"矿税使"到全国各地征收矿税和商税。矿税使在各地以搜查矿藏为名，肆意敲诈勒索富户和商人，甚至挖掘民墓、拆毁民房。各地民众的反抗和民变此起彼伏。矿税使的横行是万历后期朝政腐败的缩影，严重破坏了社会生产和商业发展，加速了明朝的衰落。
statement.en:
From the 24th year of Wanli (1596) onward, the Wanli Emperor, seeking to replenish the depleted treasury, dispatched eunuchs as 'mine and tax commissioners' to collect mining and commercial taxes nationwide. The commissioners, under the pretext of searching for ore, extorted money from wealthy households and merchants, even digging up graves and demolishing houses. Popular resistance and uprisings broke out repeatedly. The mine and tax commissioners' depredations were emblematic of the late Wanli court's corruption, severely disrupting social production and commerce and accelerating the Ming's decline.

For Asia in 1596, “Ming Mine Tax Commissioners Begin Rampage” is a traceable node of Economy change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 明万历二十五年（1597年），朝鲜水军将领李舜臣在鸣梁海峡（今韩国珍岛附近）以12艘战船（主要为改良的龟船）迎战日军约130艘战舰。李舜臣利用海峡潮汐和水流制造的战略优势，使日军舰船在狭窄水道中互相碰撞、阵型混乱。朝军击沉日军战船约30艘，自己无一损失。鸣梁海战大胜使朝鲜保住了最后的水师力量，为明军后续反攻争取了时间。

statement.zh: 明万历25年（1597年）。朝鲜水军将领李舜臣在鸣梁海峡（今韩国珍岛附近）以12艘战船（主要为改良的龟船）迎战日军约130艘战舰。李舜臣利用海峡潮汐和水流制造的战略优势，使日军舰船在狭窄水道中互相碰撞、阵型混乱。朝军击沉日军战船约30艘，自己无一损失。鸣梁海战大胜使朝鲜保住了最后的水师力量，为明军后续反攻争取了时间。
statement.en:
In 1597 (25th year of Wanli), Korean naval commander Yi Sun-shin, with only 12 ships (mainly improved turtle ships), fought a Japanese fleet of about 130 vessels at Myeongnyang Strait (off Jindo, South Korea). Yi used the strong tides and narrow channel to disrupt the Japanese formation, causing the Japanese ships to collide and break formation. The Koreans sank about 30 Japanese ships without losing any. The Myeongnyang victory preserved the remaining Korean navy, buying time for the Ming counteroffensive.

It sits within the timeline's chronological coverage of Korea and military history.

The event is treated as one node in a longer sequence of change across Asia.

The entry is kept as a concise record of that wider process rather than a standalone narrative.

zh: 明万历25年（1597年）。朝鲜水军将领李舜臣在鸣梁海峡（今韩国珍岛附近）以12艘战船（主要为改良的龟船）迎战日军约130艘战舰。李舜臣利用海峡潮汐和水流制造的战略优势，使日军舰船在狭窄水道中互相碰撞、阵型混乱。朝军击沉日军战船约30艘，自己无一损失。鸣梁海战大胜使朝鲜保住了最后的水师力量，为明军后续反攻争取了时间。
en: In 1597 (25th year of Wanli), Korean naval commander Yi Sun-shin, with only 12 ships (mainly improved turtle ships), fought a Japanese fleet of about 130 vessels at Myeongnyang Strait (off Jindo, South Korea). Yi used the strong tides and narrow channel to disrupt the Japanese formation, causing the Japanese ships to collide and break formation. The Koreans sank about 30 Japanese ships without losing any. The Myeongnyang victory preserved the remaining Korean navy, buying time for the Ming counteroffensive.

title.zh: 卡拉瓦乔开创巴洛克艺术

summary.zh: 公元1597年，意大利画家米开朗基罗·梅里西·达·卡拉瓦乔（Caravaggio）创作了《美杜莎》等作品。他运用"酒窖光线法"（强烈的明暗对比——tenebrism），使画面具有强烈的戏剧性和真实感。卡拉瓦乔的现实主义风格（包括使用下层民众作为模特画圣经人物）对欧洲绘画产生了革命性影响，开启了巴洛克艺术的新时代。

statement.zh: 丰臣秀吉在伏见城病逝，享年61岁。临终前他托付五大老（德川家康、前田利家等）和五奉行辅佐幼子丰臣秀赖，但秀吉死后各派力量很快爆发冲突。1600年关原之战中德川家康击败石田三成等丰臣系势力，最终取代丰臣氏建立了江户幕府。
statement.en:
Toyotomi Hideyoshi died at Fushimi Castle, aged 61. On his deathbed, he entrusted his young son Toyotomi Hideyori to the Council of Five Elders (Tokugawa Ieyasu, Maeda Toshiie, etc.) and the Five Commissioners. But after his death, the various powers quickly fell into conflict. At the Battle of Sekigahara in 1600, Tokugawa Ieyasu defeated the Toyotomi loyalists, eventually supplanting the Toyotomi clan and establishing the Edo Shogunate.

For Asia in 1598, “Toyotomi Hideyoshi Dies” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

statement.zh: 明万历26年（1598年）11月19日，中朝联合水师在朝鲜露梁（今庆尚南道南海郡）与撤退的日军舰队展开决战。朝鲜水军统制使李舜臣和明朝水军副总兵邓子龙指挥联军约800艘战船截击日军500余艘舰船。此战击沉日舰约200艘，但李舜臣和邓子龙均壮烈牺牲。露梁海战是壬辰倭乱的最后一场大战。
statement.en:
On 19 November 1598 (26th year of Wanli), a joint Sino-Korean fleet under Korean Admiral Yi Sun-shin and Ming Deputy Commander Deng Zilong engaged the retreating Japanese fleet at Noryang (off Namhae, South Gyeongsang Province). The allied fleet of about 800 ships fought about 500 Japanese ships. The battle sank about 200 Japanese ships, but both Yi Sun-shin and Deng Zilong were killed. The Battle of Noryang was the final major battle of the Imjin War.

For Asia in 1598, “Battle of Noryang” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

1600年的教皇国，「布鲁诺被烧死」属于宗教领域。
statement.en: Bruno's death became a symbol of the conflict between scientific inquiry and religious dogma.

statement.zh:
以镂空花版与蓝靛防染的蓝印花布在江南民间普及，纹样质朴吉祥，是百姓日常衣被面料。做法刻油纸花版，以石灰与豆粉调成防染浆刮印，浸入蓝靛后去浆，得到蓝地白花或白地蓝花；纹样多取花鸟、吉语与几何。染坊与织户由此形成乡村的手工网络。

把「蓝印花布行销江南」放回1600年的中国，可以看到工艺变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Stencil-and-indigo resist blue calico became common in Jiangnan; its simple auspicious motifs clothed everyday folk.

title.zh: 英国东印度公司获特许

summary.zh: 公元1600年12月31日，英国女王伊丽莎白一世授予伦敦商人集团皇家特许状，成立英国东印度公司，并获得好望角以东为期十五年的贸易垄断权。

statement.zh: 公元1600年12月31日，英国女王伊丽莎白一世授予伦敦商人集团皇家特许状，成立英国东印度公司，并获得好望角以东为期十五年的贸易垄断权。公司以合股集资、季度拍卖与武装商船经营香料与棉布，董事会向王室纳款换取特权；伦敦的商人资本由此把远洋贸易组织成常设机构。
statement.en: On December 31, 1600 CE, Queen Elizabeth I of England granted a royal charter to the London merchant group, established the British East India Company, and obtained a fifteen-year trade monopoly east of the Cape of Good Hope.

statement.en: The Apache tribes are famous for their mobile guerrillas and mounted warfare in the arid mountains of the southwestern United States and northern Mexico.

title.zh: 克里族亚北极狩猎社会

summary.zh: 克里族广布于加拿大亚北极森林与苔原，以驼鹿、北美野牛狩猎与皮毛贸易为生，是北美分布最广的原住民之一。

statement.zh: 克里族广布于加拿大亚北极森林与苔原，以驼鹿、北美野牛狩猎与皮毛贸易为生，是北美分布最广的原住民之一。他们随季节在森林与苔原之间迁徙，以家族与地方群体组织狩猎；皮毛贸易把内陆猎场与哈德逊湾的商站连接起来。生活方式适应寒冷与稀疏资源的北方环境。
statement.en: The Cree people are widely distributed in the subarctic forests and tundra of Canada.

title.zh: 威廉·吉尔伯特发表《论磁石》

summary.zh: 英国医生和物理学家威廉·吉尔伯特出版《论磁石、磁体与地球大磁石》。通过大量实验，他提出地球本身是一个巨大的磁体，并区分了磁力与电力。这部著作被认为是近代物理学和磁学的奠基之作，首次系统研究了电磁现象，对后来的开普勒和伽利略产生了重要影响。

zh: 英国医生和物理学家威廉·吉尔伯特出版《论磁石、磁体与地球大磁石》。
en: The English physician and physicist William Gilbert published 'De Magnete, Magneticisque Corporibus, et de Magno Magnete Tellure' (On the Magnet and Magnetic Bodies, and on the Great Magnet the Earth).

statement.zh: 休伦诸部在五大湖南岸结成联盟，以玉米园艺与皮毛贸易网络著称，后在与易洛魁的竞争中衰落离散。村落以玉米种植与季节性迁徙相结合，贸易网络把内陆猎场与法国商人的据点连接起来；联盟以议事与亲属关系维系各部落。十七世纪战争与疫病打击之后，群体逐渐分散。
